Admins add colleagues themselves

<!-- mach:idea v1 -->

## Problem

Admins email support to bring a colleague in, and wait a day.

## Proposed outcome

An admin adds a colleague themselves, the same day.

## Affected users and systems

Team admins; new colleagues; the support team.

## Constraints

Only people in the company may be added.
Not part of this idea: removing people.

## Open questions

- Should the colleague have to accept?
- Is there a limit on team size?
